hero.title3: right in the heart of Oldenburg
hero.subtitle: Taj Mahal in Oldenburg: Indian cuisine with Tandoori, Curry and vegetarian dishes, open daily for lunch and dinner.
hero.orderBtn: Online Order (10% off Pickup, 5% off Delivery)

offers.title: Save on your next feast
offers.desc: We want you to get the most out of our kitchen. That's why we regularly offer special discounts. Save on your next order and try our new specialties. Whether you pick up your food or have it delivered, there is always a reason to celebrate with Taj Mahal.

hours.title: Opening Hours
hours.desc: We are open 7 days a week for lunch and dinner. Our kitchen is always in motion and prepares fresh meals from 12:00 PM. Whether you come for a quick lunch break or a relaxed dinner, a perfect table is always ready for you.

specials.title: From the Tandoori and the Curry Pan
specials.desc: Our master chefs have dedicated their lives to perfecting the art of Indian cooking. From the smoky depths of our traditional clay oven to the rich, slow-cooked sauces, every dish is a masterpiece. Discover our most beloved creations.

menu.title: Our Menu
menu.desc: Discover our full menu with a wide range of appetizers, traditional curries, biryanis and freshly baked bread. Order online for quick pickup or let us deliver the flavors of India directly to your home.

cozy.title: Cozy and Traditional
cozy.desc1: Inside you sit comfortably in a traditional atmosphere and the waiters are ready for you. On request we also deliver or keep your food ready for pickup.
cozy.desc2: At Tajmahal we cook according to traditional Nepalese and Indian recipes. Whether you want mild, medium-hot or spicy, you decide how flavorful your dish will be. Enjoy Tandoori, Curries and vegetarian dishes in a cozy atmosphere with family and friends, or order online for delivery or pickup.

reserve.title: Book your table
reserve.desc: Are you planning to come? Fill in your details below and we will contact you shortly to confirm your table. We look forward to welcoming you at the Taj Mahal!
